pages.title: The long line · 1/3
paragraphs: It is early morning at a big DMV office in Atlanta. Many people sit on plastic chairs and wait. Davi holds a number and an old license. His license ends this month. A screen shows a red number and a green one. Finally, they call his number.
“Next! What can I do for you?” says Pam. “I want to renew my driver license.” says Davi. “Okay. Do you have your old license with you?” says Pam.
